supersedes_run.reason: The original algebra was correct but used an MP symbol that could be misread as Planck mass. The mature BPS formulation uses an independent higher-spatial-derivative scale M_* in P(Delta/M_*^2), Q(Delta/M_*^2).

primary_source: Blas, Pujolas, Sibiryakov, Models of non-relativistic quantum gravity: The good, the bad and the healthy, arXiv:1007.3503, Eqs. (5.1)-(5.8)
higher_derivative_scale_semantics: Muv denotes the source-paper independent M_* scale and is not identified with Planck mass.

source_paper_quadratic_stability.gradient_ratio: P(x)/Q(x)>0 for x<0 because P>0 and Q(-u)>0

theorem: The BPS healthy nonprojectable Horava scalar quadratic sector contains a continuous two-branch coefficient family whose pole/dispersion is exactly the RTK rational mixed-kinetic form while satisfying the BPS Minkowski scalar ghost/gradient conditions.
important_scope_guard: This is an exact pole/dispersion embedding after integrating nondynamical BPS fields. It is not proof that the reduced BPS off-shell quadratic kernel, propagator residue, matter/source coupling, or gauge-invariant observable transfer functions equal the constructive RTK mixed-kinetic EFT. The independently machine-checked pole/residue distinction result must accompany this theorem.
uv_guard: The exact rational tuning cancels the generic higher-p spatial powers in P and therefore does not by itself retain the standard BPS z=3 p^6 ultraviolet scalar dispersion. It should be regarded as a finite-range/intermediate-EFT pole embedding unless an additional higher crossover restores z=3 behavior.
relation_to_previous_nogo: The family uses the broader higher-spatial-operator healthy nonprojectable Horava class and lies outside the previously excluded constant-ci c4=2 khronometric subspace; the earlier narrow no-go does not apply.
